name: Lune
source:
The redhead Demoness. She calls Laste by her first name. Unlike Laste she's self-confident, strong-willed and shows her emotions. She looks impulsive and happy-go-lucky, but she's surprisingly calculating and accommodating (which is a rarity among Demonesses). She's not fond of provoking conflict.

She can "Ignite" anything in her line of sight.
